name: disprove-bound-query
description: One SQL injection claim is real (search_notes interpolates the term); the other flags a query that binds its parameter

findings.body: `orders_for` builds its SQL from `customer_id`, which allows SQL injection.
findings.evidence: cur = conn.execute("SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = ?", (customer_id,))

findings.body: `search_notes` interpolates `term` into the SQL string with an f-string, which allows SQL injection.
findings.evidence: query = f"SELECT id, body FROM notes WHERE body LIKE '%{term}%'"
